item.title: Schwab Wants to Choose WEF Successor, Says Chairs Fink &amp; Hoffmann Shouldn't Have Conflicts of Interests, Is Tightlipped on Borge-Epstein Connection: Swiss Media
item.description: World Economic Forum (WEF) founder Klaus Schwab tells Swiss media he's exploring ways to choose his successor, that he won't comment further on Borge Brende's connections to Jeffrey Epstein, and that board members like interim co-chairs Larry Fink and Andre Hoffmann shouldn't have conflicts of interests.

item.title: World Models: The architectural bet behind AI's next frontier

item.title: From one donor, thousands of doses: Meet the startup making cell therapy accessible
item.description: Startup ImmuneBridge is scaling allogeneic cell therapy with ML-driven donor selection and stem cell preservation to expand treatment access.

item.title: DARPA O-Circuit Wants Drones that Can Smell Danger: 'A New Class of Bio Inspired Computer'
item.description: DARPA's O-Circuit program looks to build a new class of biologically inspired computer equipped with odorant sensing systems that would allow drones to smell danger, such as explosives and chemical agents, using olfactory receptor neurons.
